title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions.
